scope: Clarifies exact fixed-Q equality and reflected-Q mapping, not a new input class or a review of the uniform theorem.
positive_shrink: Let psi=product_i u_i and 0<t=1-p<1. The actual output's top eigenvalue a^4 is simple with eigenvector psi; the second value a^3 b has multiplicity four with eigenvectors e_i=u_1 tensor ... tensor u_i_perp tensor ... tensor u_4. All other eigenvalues are strictly smaller. An actual rank-three Q attains R3 iff Q=|psi><psi|+R, where R is ANY orthogonal rank-two projector inside span{e_1,e_2,e_3,e_4}. This is the complete fixed-Q condition at nontrivial positive shrinkage, including the cutoff degeneracy.
negative_shrink: For p>1 and t=p-1, the maximizing Q are exactly the inverse images under J_global(Q)=Y^tensor4 Q^T Y^tensor4 of the positive-shrink maximizing projectors at p'=2-p. In physical product notation let Theta_i u_i=Y conjugate(u_i) and Theta_i u_i_perp=Y conjugate(u_i_perp). The simple largest-eigenvalue vector is tensor_i Theta_i u_i, orthogonal on every local factor to psi; the next eigenspace is spanned by the four vectors obtained by replacing exactly one Theta_i u_i by Theta_i u_i_perp. The same rank-one-plus-any-rank-two description applies in this transformed basis. In particular the top vector at p>1 is generally NOT the input vector; 141 correctly proves positive-shrink intersections first and then uses the global mirror for the negative side.
proof: The full transpose/unitary J_global is an involution, maps orthogonal projectors and ranks bijectively, and satisfies Tr[Q Lambda_p(rho)]=Tr[J_global(Q) Lambda_(2-p)(rho)]. The eigenvalue variational principle forces Q to contain all eigenspaces strictly above the cutoff and to select the required dimensional subspace in the cutoff eigenspace. No premise of all-state k3 is needed for these product-input statements.
nonclaims: This does not establish strictness for arbitrary nonproduct rho, the conditional mixed equality characterization in 141 without the full unreviewed 121 proof, novelty, formal/human/cross-family acceptance, or a historical process cure. Mandatory source corrections and the separately disclosed cadence/withdrawal findings remain.
